subject: Fee reallocation & rollback procedure — order form redlines
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aurora-ml.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora ML Procurement <procurement@aurora-ml.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: fee reallocation + rollback language for capacity add

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Our engineering leadership wants to proceed with the additional GPU capacity for Q1, but they asked us to tighten up the change-order language before we sign anything. Two asks from procurement/legal: 1) a clear fee reallocation line that allows us to move spend between exhibits (we will likely shift 20% of the initial commitment from Exhibit A to Exhibit C over the first 6 months), and 2) a rollback/termination procedure that protects Aurora ML if performance targets aren't met during the phased cutover.

Can Redwood provide a redline of the order form and SOW that:
- Adds a short paragraph on intra-exhibit reallocation (proration method + 30-day notice),
- Includes a rollback option tied to 5-day SLA misses during the initial 30-day ramp, and
- Confirms how credits/proration would be calculated if capacity is reduced mid-billing cycle.

I'm attaching our marked copy for reference. We need to present signed docs to our finance and legal teams by COB Nov 24 to hit our internal procurement window.

Attachments: Aurora_marked_orderform.pdf (annotated), SOW_ExhibitC_req.xlsx

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Operations, Aurora ML
samir@aurora-ml.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@aurora-ml.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: fee reallocation + rollback language for capacity add

Marissa / Jonas — looping you both in so we can move quickly.

Summary of request from Aurora ML:
- Move ~20% of committed spend from Exhibit A to Exhibit C over 6 months (they want a simple reallocation clause).
- Add a rollback/termination path if 5-day SLA misses occur during 30-day ramp.
- Clarify proration/credit calculation when capacity is reduced mid-cycle.

Proposed internal plan:
1) Legal to draft a one-paragraph "Intra-Exhibit Reallocation" clause with notice and proration math (Jonas).
2) Legal to add a narrowly scoped rollback paragraph tied to measured SLA exceptions during the initial ramp period (Jonas).
3) Commercial to confirm whether we can accept a 30-day ramp + 5-day SLA-triggered rollback with finance to pre-approve proration (Marissa).

Jonas — can you produce a redline for the order form + Exhibit C and a short rationale for the rollback language (risk exposure and guardrails)? If possible please attach a PDF we can share with Aurora.

Marissa — once Jonas gives us the wording, can you confirm we can implement the 20% reallocation and call out any billing implications (credits/proration) so we can present a clean doc to their procurement by COB 11/24?

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8472 — I'm tagging this as time-sensitive.

Thanks,
Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@aurora-ml.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: fee reallocation + rollback language for capacity add

Mina / Marissa — I reviewed Aurora's annotated copy. Attached is a PDF with tracked redlines (legal_redlines_orderform.pdf). High-level notes: 

1) Intra-Exhibit Reallocation: draft language allows reallocation up to 25% of the then-current commitment between Exhibits A and C with 30 days' written notice. Proration: we propose pro-rating on a per-day basis using the actual tokens/throughput used in the billing month; finance will need to confirm the exact rounding approach.

2) Rollback / Performance Escalation: I added a narrow rollback trigger: if the rolling 30-day period during ramp shows >5 SLA misses per 10k requests AND engineering cannot remediate within a 5-business-day remediation window, Aurora may elect to revert the newly provisioned capacity. Revert would be accompanied by a pro-rated credit calculated from the date of rollback to the end of the billing period.

3) SLAs & Measurement: we should reference the same telemetry source (token-level latency buckets in our Console) as the measurement authority to avoid disputes. Also recommended: an advisory call with our SRE within 48 hours of any reported misses before rollback is executed.

4) Risk: rollback adds operational complexity; we want to limit customer access to a single rollback per ramp to avoid churn gaming. I included that guardrail.

Next steps:
- Mina: confirm operational feasibility for a single rollback and that SRE can commit to the 48-hour advisory window.
- Marissa: confirm finance's proration rounding (I included a provisional formula in the redline PDF).

If you both agree, I'll convert these edits into a DocuSign-ready order form and send back to Samir.

Attachment: legal_redlines_orderform.pdf

Jonas
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@aurora-ml.com>, Finance Billing <finance-billing@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: fee reallocation + rollback language for capacity add

All — quick confirm from commercial & finance:
- We can support the 20% reallocation (Jonas' 25% cap is fine). We'll implement per-day proration with rounding to the nearest dollar; finance-billing, please confirm final rounding but this is the operational approach.
- One allowed rollback per ramp window is acceptable; SRE advisory call within 48 hours is operationally feasible.
- I'll coordinate the DocuSign after Jonas finalizes the edits. Samir — we'll aim to get a DocuSign link to you by EOD today so you can get internal sign-off by COB 11/24.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redlined_orderform_v2.pdf, SOW_ExhibitC_markup.docx
